redact.drop: Drop the image here or click to choose one — pasting (Ctrl+V) works too
redact.label.stage: Drag over what you want gone — as many times as you like
redact.status.idle: The image stays in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
redact.say.loaded: Drag over what you want hidden. It is not covered up — those pixels are gone.
redact.err.open: Could not open that image. Try another file.
redact.err.tooSmall: Too small, so it was skipped. Drag a proper rectangle over the area.
redact.say.added: {n} area(s) erased. Hide more, or download it right away.
redact.say.pixel: Pixelation is known to be reversible for text. Use black-out for anything that truly must stay hidden.
redact.say.fill: Black-out cannot be undone. Those pixels stop existing.
redact.err.render: Could not turn it into an image.
redact.say.saved: Downloaded {size}. The hidden areas are gone from the file too, and the location data the photo carried came off with it.
